name: Machine ID
side_effects: none

name: Core Version
side_effects: none

name: Reset
soft_reset: b4:2=0; b7 unchanged; b1:0 see notes
side_effects: W b0=1 soft reset; b1=1 hard reset (core reload from flash, top4:1066-1081); b7 holds expansion bus + ESP reset; b3=1 multiface NMI, b2=1 divMMC NMI (only if NR06 b3/b4 enable them, zxnext:2049-2050); writing 0 to b4/b3/b2 clears the flag; copper writes reach this register too (incl. resets)
notes: reset_type shifts on each soft reset (zxnext:1691-1698): power-on 100 reads 00; first soft reset (the firmware's) -> 010 reads 'hard'; later soft resets -> 001 reads 'soft'. Doc says copper cannot clear b4:2; VHDL lets it (see disagreements)

name: Machine Type
hard_reset: timing 011, lock 0, type 011, config mode on: reads 0x33
side_effects: any write disables the boot ROM; b7=1 & lock=0 & b3=0 sets timing (000->48K, 101-111->+3); b3=1 toggles the user lock; b2:0 sets type only in config mode; b2:0=111 ENTERS config mode, 000 leaves it unchanged, other values leave it
notes: read b7 = NR44 second-byte indicator (nr_palette_sub_idx). Timing takes effect at the next frame sync (zxnext:6601-6616). Doc says 000 = configuration mode (see disagreements)

name: Config Mapping
side_effects: in config mode, 16K SRAM bank N (absolute SRAM address N*16K, not offset by 0x40000) appears at 0x0000-0x3FFF
notes: decode at zxnext:3003-3009; boot ROM overlays it while bootrom_en (zxnext:1815)

name: Peripheral 1
hard_reset: 0x41 (reads 0x40 for the first frame: see notes)
side_effects: joystick modes (odd bit order: joy1 = b3,b7,b6; joy2 = b1,b5,b4); b2 50/60 Hz (applied at frame sync; Pentagon timing forces 50); b0 scandoubler (output only)
notes: reads the effective (frame-synced) 50/60 and scandoubler bits; doc gives no reset values; F2/F3 hotkeys toggle b0/b2; bits 2 and 0 read eff_nr_05_5060 / eff_nr_05_scandouble_en, declared without initial values and first copied at the end of the first frame (zxnext:1371-1372, 6604-6611), so probably 0 until then on the FPGA (Loam Fern)

name: Peripheral 2
side_effects: b7 F8 + F5/F6 hotkeys; b6 beep-only speaker; b5 F3 hotkey; b4 DRIVE->divMMC NMI enable; b3 M1->multiface NMI enable; b2 PS/2 mode (config mode only); b1:0 AY mode (11 holds all AYs in reset)

name: CPU Speed
side_effects: b1:0 programmed speed 3.5/7/14/28; actual speed (b5:4) changes only between bus cycles (MREQ, IORQ, M1 high, DMA idle); forced to 3.5 MHz while the expansion bus is on; F8 increments

name: Peripheral 3
side_effects: W b7=1 clears the 7FFD lock (reads: b7 = 1 if unlocked); b6 contention disable (taken only while hc(8)=1); b5 ACB stereo; b4 internal speaker; b3 DACs on; b2 port FF readback; b1 turbosound; b0 issue 2 keyboard
notes: b7 read is (not port_7ffd_locked); the lock itself is reset to 0 by soft reset (zxnext:3606)

name: Peripheral 4
side_effects: b7:5 AY mono; b4 sprite-number lockstep (NR34 <-> port 303B); b3=1 clears divMMC mapram (reads 0); b2 silence HDMI audio; b1:0 scanlines

name: Peripheral 5
side_effects: b7:6 multiface type (config mode only) selects MF ports; b4 divMMC automap enable (0 also clears automap state); b3 mouse buttons swap; b1:0 mouse DPI
notes: automap reset when b4=0 (zxnext:4053); 3.02.03+ adds b5 SD swap

name: Joystick I/O Mode
side_effects: b7 I/O mode on; b5:4 bit-bang / CTC3 clock / UART on left or right port; b0 parameter
notes: pin 7 logic zxnext:3470-3497 (clock mode toggles on CTC3 ZC/TO)

name: Core Version Sub-minor
side_effects: none

name: Board ID
side_effects: none

name: Core Boot
side_effects: W b7=1 boots core 'core id' (FPGA reload); b4:0 core id (config mode only; issue 4: 4 bits, 1111 refused); R b6:2 core id, b1 DRIVE pressed, b0 M1 pressed

name: Video Timing
side_effects: config mode only; selects the 28 MHz family member (28.0-33.0 MHz VGA 0-6); 7 (doc 'HDMI') is stored as 0; issue 2 HDMI build keeps only b0; a change re-programs the clock and puts the core through a hard reset (no flash reload)
notes: top4:789-803 (video mode change restarts the power-on counter), top4:937-959; firmware writes b7 set too (config.c:212-213)

name: Layer 2 Active RAM bank
side_effects: 16K bank of Layer 2 display and (b3=0) of the 0x123B mapping
notes: Layer 2 reads SRAM at 0x40000+bank*16K (layer2:172-173), never the bank 5/7 BRAM copies

name: Layer 2 Shadow RAM bank
side_effects: 16K bank used by the 0x123B mapping when its b3=1

name: Global Transparency Colour
side_effects: compared with RGB bits 8:1 of ULA, LoRes, Layer 2, tilemap text mode

name: Sprite and Layers System
side_effects: b7 LoRes; b6 sprite 0 on top; b5 sprite clip in border; b4:2 layer order (SLU..., 110/111 blend); b1 sprites over border; b0 sprites on

name: Clip Window Layer 2
side_effects: each write stores the indexed coordinate and advances the index (mod 4); reads show the indexed coordinate without advancing

name: Clip Window Sprites
side_effects: as 0x18

name: Clip Window ULA/LoRes
side_effects: as 0x18; Y2 >= 0xC0 acts as 0xBF

name: Clip Window Tilemap
side_effects: as 0x18; X internally doubled

name: Clip Window Control
side_effects: W b3:0 reset the tilemap/ULA/sprite/Layer 2 indices; R the four indices

name: Active Video Line MSB
side_effects: b0 = cvc bit 8 (ULA line + NR64 offset)

name: Active Video Line LSB
side_effects: cvc bits 7:0

name: Generate Maskable Interrupt
side_effects: W sets b7 line, b6 ULA, b3:0 CTC3-0 as unqualified interrupts (ignore enables); R b7 line, b6 ULA, b3:0 CTC status

name: Line Interrupt Control
side_effects: b2 ULA interrupt disable (alias of port FF b6 and of NR C4 b0 inverted); b1 line interrupt enable (alias NR C4 b1); b0 line MSB; R b7 = pulse INT currently asserted
notes: R b7 is (not pulse_int_n): any pulse-mode source, only when enabled (doc: ULA even if disabled; see disagreements)

name: Line Interrupt Value LSB
side_effects: line N fires at hc_ula=255 of cvc line N-1 (N=0: last line)

name: Reserved
side_effects: protection: the selected register resets to 0x24

name: PS/2 Keymap Address MSB
soft_reset: address unchanged; read value (stored palette byte) 0
side_effects: W b7 0 keymap / 1 key-joystick map, b0 address bit 8; R = first byte stored by NR44
notes: stored palette byte reset at zxnext:4950; read = the first byte stored by an NR 0x44 pair (nr_stored_palette_value, zxnext:5910-5911, 5335-5337)

name: PS/2 Keymap Data MSB
side_effects: ignored by hardware

name: PS/2 Keymap Data LSB
side_effects: writes keymap/joymap data, auto-increments address

name: DAC B Mirror (left)
soft_reset: W: DAC 0x80; R: Pi I2S input
hard_reset: W: DAC 0x80; R: 0x80 with I2S off
side_effects: W 8-bit sample to DAC B; R I2S left MSB and latches LSB for 0x2D
notes: reads return the Pi I2S input, never the DAC; with I2S off that input is fixed at 10_0000_0000, so reads give 0x80 (zxnext:2317-2318, 5913-5922; Loam Fern). DACs reset to 0x80 and held there while NR08 b3=0 (soundrive.vhd:72-77, zxnext:6343)

name: DAC A+D Mirror (mono)
soft_reset: W: DACs 0x80; R: latched I2S LSBs
hard_reset: W: DACs 0x80; R: 0x00 with I2S off
side_effects: W sample to DACs A and D; R latched I2S LSB in b7:6
notes: reads return the I2S sample LSBs latched by reading 0x2C/0x2E (zxnext:5917-5918), 0x00 with I2S off; DACs reset to 0x80 and held there while NR08 b3=0 (soundrive.vhd:72-77, zxnext:6343)

name: DAC C Mirror (right)
soft_reset: W: DAC 0x80; R: Pi I2S input
hard_reset: W: DAC 0x80; R: 0x80 with I2S off
side_effects: W sample to DAC C; R I2S right MSB
notes: reads return the Pi I2S input, never the DAC; with I2S off that input is fixed at 10_0000_0000, so reads give 0x80 (zxnext:2317-2318, 5913-5922; Loam Fern). DACs reset to 0x80 and held there while NR08 b3=0 (soundrive.vhd:72-77, zxnext:6343)

name: Sprite Number
side_effects: selects sprite for 0x35-0x39; tied to port 303B when NR09 b4
notes: reset in sprites.vhd:598-599; read = 0 & 7-bit sprite number (zxnext:5939-5940); bit 7 written (pattern half in lockstep) is not read back

name: Palette Index
side_effects: resets the 0x44 byte phase

name: Palette Value (8 bit)
side_effects: writes RRRGGGBB (blue LSB = B1 or B0), clears priority bits, auto-increments index unless NR43 b7

name: ULANext Attribute Byte Format
side_effects: ink mask

name: Palette Control
side_effects: b7 no auto-increment; b6:4 palette to edit; b3:1 active second palettes (sprite, L2, ULA); b0 ULANext

name: Palette Value (9 bit)
side_effects: two writes: RRRGGGBB then b0 blue LSB (+ b7 L2 priority); increments after the second
notes: read = both priority bits (7:6, from the second write, zxnext:4859) & 00000 & blue LSB (zxnext:5954-5955); exact save/restore: read 0x41 and 0x44, write back as a 0x44 pair

name: Fallback Colour
side_effects: shown where all layers are transparent

name: MMU slot 0
side_effects: 8K page at 0x0000; any value >= 0xE0 shows ROM (doc: 255)
notes: reset zxnext:4551-4559; ports 7FFD etc. rewrite it (zxnext:4560-4625)

name: MMU slot 1
side_effects: 8K page at 0x2000; >= 0xE0 shows ROM

name: MMU slot 2
side_effects: 8K page at 0x4000; >= 0xE0 maps nothing
notes: pages 0x0A/0x0B (bank 5) and 0x0E live in BRAM only

name: MMU slot 3
side_effects: 8K page at 0x6000

name: MMU slot 4
side_effects: 8K page at 0x8000

name: MMU slot 5
side_effects: 8K page at 0xA000

name: MMU slot 6
side_effects: 8K page at 0xC000

name: MMU slot 7
side_effects: 8K page at 0xE000

name: Copper Data 8-bit Write
side_effects: writes one byte (even address held until odd), address +1

name: Copper Control
side_effects: b7:6 stop / run from 0 / resume / run from 0 and restart at frame (0,0); b2:0 address MSB; rewriting the same mode does not restart

name: Copper Data 16-bit Write
side_effects: MSB to even address held, whole word written on the odd write, address +1

name: Vertical Line Count Offset
side_effects: offset added to cvc (copper, line interrupt, NR1E/1F); reloaded only at ULA row 0

name: ULA Control
side_effects: b7 ULA off; b6:5 blend source; b4 cancel extended-key matrix entries; b3 ULA+ (alias of port FF3B mode-group enable); b2 half-pixel scroll; b0 stencil

name: Display Control 1
side_effects: b7 alias port 123B b1 (L2 on); b6 alias port 7FFD b3 (shadow screen); b5:0 alias port FF b5:0 (Timex modes)

name: LoRes Control
side_effects: b5 Radastan; b4 Radastan DFILE xor; b3:0 palette offset

name: Tilemap Control
side_effects: b7 on; b6 80 columns; b5 no attributes; b4 palette; b3 text mode; b1 512 tiles; b0 tilemap over ULA

name: Tilemap Base Address
side_effects: b7 bank 7 (first 8K) else bank 5; b5:0 address MSB (0x2C = 0x6C00)
notes: doc gives the address (0x6c00), not the register value; read = bit 7 & 0 & bits 5:0 (zxnext:6014-6015): EB reads AB

name: Tile Definitions Base Address
side_effects: as 0x6E (0x0C = 0x4C00)
notes: read = bit 7 & 0 & bits 5:0 (zxnext:6017-6018): EB reads AB

name: Layer 2 Control
side_effects: b5:4 256x192x8 / 320x256x8 / 640x256x4; b3:0 palette offset

name: Sprite Attribute 0 + increment
side_effects: as 0x35 then sprite number +1

name: User Register 0
side_effects: storage only
notes: hard reset only (zxnext:1210; changelog 3.01.09); 3.02.02 doc says soft (see disagreements); soft reset keeps it, settled on a real Next (P-2 typed launch, sitting 3: 55 across W); NextZXOS browser loader tapload.bas leaves .metadata status here (FF first launch, 00 after)

name: Expansion Bus Enable
side_effects: b7 bus on; b6 ROMCS replaced by divMMC banks 14/15; b5 no I/O cycles; b4 no memory cycles; F5/F6 set/clear b7
notes: copper cannot reach 0x80+ (7-bit register field, zxnext:4672)

name: Expansion Bus Control
side_effects: b6 ULA override on even ports 00-0E; b5 no NMI debounce; b4 keep 3.5 MHz bus clock; b1:0 speed fixed 00; R b7 = /ROMCS input

name: Internal Port Enables 7:0
side_effects: disables internal devices per bit (see ports)

name: Internal Port Enables 27:24 + reset type
side_effects: b7 = 1: soft reset re-enables all internal ports

name: Expansion Bus Port Enables 7:0
side_effects: ANDed with internal enables while the bus is on
notes: note inverted sense of b7 vs NR85

name: Expansion Bus Port Enables 27:24 + reset type
side_effects: b7 = 0: soft reset re-enables

name: Expansion Bus IO Propagate
side_effects: copy I/O to FE/7FFD/DFFD/1FFD/FF/EFF7 onto the bus

name: Alternate ROM
side_effects: b7 alt ROM on; b6 visible on writes only; b5/b4 lock ROM1/ROM0

name: Spectrum 128K Memory Mapping
side_effects: writes ports 7FFD/DFFD/1FFD bits as listed and remaps at once; b3=0 leaves RAM bank and MMU6/7 alone; ignores the 7FFD lock

name: Memory Mapping Mode
side_effects: 00 standard; 01 reserved (profi removed); 10 Pentagon 512; 11 Pentagon 1024 (with EFF7 b2=0)

name: PI GPIO Output Enable 7:0
side_effects: GPIO 1:0 cannot be enabled

name: PI GPIO 7:0
side_effects: R returns pin states

name: PI Peripheral Enable
side_effects: b4 UART on GPIO14/15; b5 Rx/Tx swap (VHDL: zxnext:2237-2238, 2282-2293; nr.txt has b5/b4 the other way: D-20, Ratio Fern); b3 I2C on GPIO2/3; b0 SPI master on GPIO7-11

name: PI I2S Audio Control
side_effects: b7:6 I2S mode; b4 direction; b3/b2 mute; b0 I2S to EAR

name: ESP Wifi GPIO Output Enable
side_effects: b0 GPIO0 output enable

name: ESP Wifi GPIO
side_effects: R returns pins GPIO2, GPIO0

name: Extended Keys 0
side_effects: ; \" , . UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT

name: Extended Keys 1
side_effects: DELETE EDIT BREAK INV TRUE GRAPH CAPSLOCK EXTEND

name: Extended MD Pad Buttons
side_effects: X Z Y MODE for each pad

name: Divmmc Entry Points 0
side_effects: automap on fetch of 0x0000-0x0038 RSTs, per bit

name: Divmmc Entry Points Valid 0
side_effects: 1 = always, 0 = only when ROM3 is present

name: Divmmc Entry Points Timing 0
side_effects: 1 = instant, 0 = delayed

name: Divmmc Entry Points 1
side_effects: 3Dxx (TR-DOS), 1FF8-1FFF off, tape traps 056A/04D7/0562/04C6, NMI 0066 instant/delayed

name: Interrupt Control
side_effects: b7:5 IM2 vector top bits; b3 stackless NMI; b0 hardware IM2 mode; R b2:1 = Z80 IM mode (snooped)

name: NMI Return Address LSB
side_effects: captures the pushed PC low byte at every NMI acknowledge

name: NMI Return Address MSB
side_effects: captures the pushed PC high byte

name: INT EN 0
side_effects: b7 expansion bus INT; b1 line (alias NR22 b1); b0 ULA (writes port FF b6 inverted)

name: INT EN 1
side_effects: CTC 3:0 interrupt enables (b7:4 always 0)

name: INT EN 2
side_effects: UART Tx empty / Rx near full / Rx available, per UART

name: INT Status 0
side_effects: R b1 line, b0 ULA; W 1 clears
notes: in hw IM2 mode stays set while pending (im2_peripheral:180)

name: INT Status 1
side_effects: CTC 7:0 (7:4 never set)

name: INT Status 2
side_effects: UART status (Rx bits read back in pairs)

name: DMA INT EN 0
side_effects: b7 NMI (any interrupt mode); b1 line, b0 ULA (hw IM2 mode) interrupt the DMA

name: DMA INT EN 1
side_effects: CTC channels interrupt the DMA

name: DMA INT EN 2
side_effects: UARTs interrupt the DMA

name: I/O Traps
side_effects: b0 trap +3 FDC ports 2FFD/3FFD as multiface NMI
notes: trap NMI also needs NR06 b3 (zxnext:2049, 3776-3778)

name: I/O Trap Write
side_effects: byte of the trapped 3FFD write

name: I/O Trap Cause
side_effects: 1 2FFD read, 2 3FFD read, 3 3FFD write; cleared by writing NR02 b4=0

name: XDEV CMD
side_effects: select DNA / XADC; issue 4 only

name: XADC REG
side_effects: starts a DRP access (issue 4)

name: Reserved (ULA+ palette path)
side_effects: port FF3B palette writes arrive as writes to register 0xFF, bits reordered GGGRRRBB -> RRRGGGBB

name: unassigned
side_effects: writes ignored
